nodes.description: Source. Parser creation imports the attacker-controlled decoder-list pointer from the harness into project state by storing caller-owned `decoders` in `p->decoders` before creation has succeeded.

Root cause. On a create-time `time_offset` parse failure, vulnerable `flb_parser_create()` unwinds with the full `flb_parser_destroy(p)` even though `p->decoders` still aliases caller-owned state and the function is about to return `NULL`.

ASan sink. The second `flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy(list)` starts iterating a list head that was already freed during the create-time unwind, so the loop reads stale list pointers and triggers the heap-use-after-free READ of size 8 reported at line 743.
